    "def get_read_tdx_data(path):\n",

    "\t\t\t选择股票\n",
    "\t\t\t'''\n",
    "\t\t\tstock=str(x)\n",

    "\t\t\t\tstock=stock[1:]\n",
    "\t\t\t\tstock=str(stock)+'.SZ'\n",

    "\t\t\t\tstock=stock[1:]\n",

    "\t\t\t\tstock=stock[1:]\n",
    "\t\t\t\tstock=str(stock)+'.SZ'\n",
    "\t\t\treturn stock\n",
    "\t\tdf['证券代码']=df['证券代码'].apply(lambda x:select_stock(x))\n",

    "\t\t\t\tprint(e)\n",
    "\t\t\t\tdf=pd.DataFrame()\n",
